dimensions.label: Circuit
dimensions.tooltip: Administrative circuit grouping from the source record.

dimensions.label: District
dimensions.tooltip: Administrative district grouping; office detail is excluded.

dimensions.definition: Calendar month of statistical filing, encoded as its first day.
dimensions.label: Filed month
dimensions.tooltip: Month precision only; this is not the exact filing day.

dimensions.definition: Calendar year derived from filed month.
dimensions.label: Filing year
dimensions.tooltip: Used for annual trends and physical partition selection.

dimensions.definition: Calendar month of statistical termination when observed.
dimensions.label: Termination month
dimensions.tooltip: Null for pending records; month precision is not an exact event day.

dimensions.definition: Whether statistical termination was unobserved at the source cutoff.
dimensions.label: Pending status
dimensions.tooltip: Pending records are right-censored, not treated as terminated.

dimensions.definition: Whether statistical termination was observed by the source cutoff.
dimensions.label: Termination observed
dimensions.tooltip: Logical inverse of pending status; not a legal outcome.

dimensions.label: Nature-of-suit code
dimensions.tooltip: Null only for explicitly unsupported legacy source values.

dimensions.label: Nature family
dimensions.tooltip: Coarse administrative case-mix grouping, not legal advice.

dimensions.definition: Whether the source nature code has exact codebook support.
dimensions.label: Nature mapping status
dimensions.tooltip: Unsupported values remain labeled rather than guessed.

dimensions.definition: Governed descriptive procedural grouping derived at intake.
dimensions.label: Procedural cohort
dimensions.tooltip: Administrative cohort only; not a legal classification.

dimensions.definition: Whether the private natural identifier is canonical or colliding.
dimensions.label: Identity quality
dimensions.tooltip: Collision rows remain statistical records and are not unique cases.

dimensions.definition: Records sharing the private natural identifier.
dimensions.label: Source-record count
dimensions.tooltip: One for canonical identity and at least two for collisions.

dimensions.definition: Whether a reviewed one-to-one RECAP identity match is available.
dimensions.label: RECAP match available
dimensions.tooltip: Availability only; no RECAP identifier or event content is exposed.

dimensions.definition: Pending follow-up grouped as under one, one to two, two to five, or at least five years.
dimensions.label: Pending age band
dimensions.tooltip: Computed only in pending-inventory context from right-censored duration.

measures.definition: Count of governed FJC statistical records in scope.
measures.label: Statistical records
measures.tooltip: One record is not guaranteed to represent one unique legal case.

measures.definition: Records whose private natural identifier occurs once in the snapshot.
measures.label: Collision-free records
measures.limitation: Snapshot uniqueness is not cross-system identity certainty.
measures.tooltip: Excludes collision-labeled statistical records from this measure only.

measures.definition: Records without observed statistical termination at the source cutoff.
measures.label: Pending records
measures.limitation: Pending status reflects the source snapshot, not current docket status.
measures.tooltip: Pending records are preserved as right-censored observations.

measures.definition: Records with statistical termination observed by the source cutoff.
measures.label: Observed terminations
measures.limitation: No outcome direction or prediction is implied.
measures.tooltip: Statistical termination is not a legal outcome classification.

measures.definition: Records with a reviewed one-to-one RECAP identity match.
measures.label: RECAP-matched records
measures.limitation: Unmatched records may still have public dockets outside the retained match rule.
measures.tooltip: Measures match availability, not docket-event coverage.

measures.definition: Records with exact codebook-supported nature-of-suit mapping.
measures.label: Mapped nature records
measures.limitation: Support is specific to the versioned mapping.
measures.tooltip: Unsupported legacy codes remain visible and are never guessed.

measures.definition: Mean filing-to-termination days among records with observed statistical termination.
measures.label: Average observed duration
measures.limitation: Not a forecast for an open or future matter.
measures.tooltip: Descriptive terminated-record average; pending records are excluded from this measure.

measures.definition: Pending records divided by all statistical records in scope.
measures.label: Pending share
measures.limitation: Not a probability that a new filing will remain open.
measures.tooltip: Snapshot inventory share with pending records preserved.

measures.definition: RECAP-matched records divided by all statistical records in scope.
measures.label: RECAP match coverage
measures.tooltip: Identity-match availability, not event or document completeness.

measures.definition: Total filing-to-termination or filing-to-cutoff days across records in scope.
measures.label: Follow-up days
measures.limitation: Additive exposure measure, not average time to disposition.
measures.tooltip: Includes observed duration and right-censored follow-up.

measures.definition: Mean filing-to-cutoff days among pending records in scope.
measures.label: Average pending age
measures.limitation: Not remaining duration or predicted time to termination.
measures.tooltip: Right-censored inventory age at the source snapshot.
